instructions.goal: Expand this brainstorm with more ideas. Add new bullets where they genuinely help; keep the voice concise and practical.
rules: Keep every existing node id exactly as provided.
Use only these roles: theme, main-branch, branch, leaf, task, idea, question, risk.
Only titles were provided; do not invent notes for existing nodes.
Append-only: never delete, rename, or re-parent existing nodes.
New nodes get fresh ids and attach under the most relevant existing node.
Return only the brainstorm tree; the update document has no map field.

returnContract: Return ONE JSON file: a brainstorm-update document (kind "brainstorm-update") with the expanded brainstorm tree and all original node ids preserved. Set "sourceProjectId" to "p-launch-1". Do not include a map.
